observability_audit.scope: Actual versus paired nominal 22-field projection differences; audit only. No current attack, no projection difference, and no class information are distinct. These annotations are not model inputs, an oracle bound, or a proof of identifiability.

observability_diagnostics.scope: descriptive only, attached after all 20 test predictions
observability_diagnostics.measurement: actual versus paired nominal 22-field projection changes within each causal L10 context
observability_diagnostics.no_change_interpretation: no measured projection change; not proof of no class information or an oracle ceiling
observability_diagnostics.outputs: per-class conditional accuracy, predicted NORMAL fraction and predicted-class counts; seed means and sample SD

protocol.research_purpose: TAES reviewer revision: 22-field representation and cross-window evidence aggregation
protocol.label_policy: retain supplied episode labels, including quiet/unobserved attack windows
protocol.audit_annotation_policy: provenance only; never features, filtering, relabeling or model selection
protocol.selection: val macro_f1; equal within 1e-12 -> lower val loss
protocol.stop: encoder meaningful-F1 plateau; TST existing strict best metric patience
limitations: 22-field representation and cross-window evidence aggregation are the revision focus
prespecified finite training rules/maxima; full convergence or equal realized compute is not claimed
model families differ in capacity and compute; encoder results at L10 are conditional on this TST control
encoder seed varies initialization where applicable and training dropout; pretrained starting weights are identical
fixed window/TST head and shuffle seeds; no crossing with the separate ten-head-seed study
random/pretrained share tokenizer/architecture/training rules; initialization weights are the intended contrast
window-common and L10 share endpoints, but head capacity/training also differ
validation selects checkpoints; held-out test evaluation and uncertainty are a later step
all eligible shared-nominal windows/endpoints are retained, including quiet or unobserved attack windows
audit annotations remain provenance/diagnostics and never select training rows, labels or checkpoints
overall F1 alone does not demonstrate attack-evidence use or rule out generator signatures; interpret with benchmark/evidence audits
